Description text: "The Sartorius PMA is a family of self-indicating, single-interval, non-automatic weighing instruments designed for paint mixing applications. The family comprises the PMA-EV (Class II) and PMA-HD (Class III) types, each comprising several models (EVO1, VIS1, LAB1, SPO1). The instrument shall not be used for direct sales to the public. Construction: plastic housing, stainless steel load receptor, plastic display head, 3 feet (2 adjustable), level indicator; LCD segment display with fixed-position touch keys (EVO1, LAB1, SPO1) or LCD graphic display with touch function (VIS1); EX-link converter for voltage supply and data transfer (X and Y models except EVO1Y). Devices: initial zero setting device (≤ 20% of Max), zero tracking device (≤ 4% of Max), zero indicator (PMA-HD only), combined zero-setting and tare-balancing device, preset tare device (only via a PC), approximate displaying device (PMA-EV only), weight accumulation, weight calculating. Interfaces: USB either directly (S models and EVO1Y) or via Ex-link converter (EVO1X and LAB1X); Ethernet via Ex-link converter (VIS1X and VIS1Y models). A PC with compatible paint mixing software can be connected; all devices can be initiated via a PC; preset tare can only be introduced via a PC. Power supply: 5 V DC provided by USB; for X and Y models except EVO1Y power is delivered from USB to the Ex-link converter and then to the instrument via RJ-45. Sealing: access to the electronics and load cell is prevented by two tamper-evident labels on the underside; access to the menu access switch is prevented by a tamper-evident label."
